title: Pre-approval of the clerk#197 dogfood sequence (2026-10-25)

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-25, choosing this option in answer to the question: "Do you pre-approve the clerk#197 dogfood sequence (W1–W7)? If yes, I record your answer as a decision ratified in a session, cite it in every PR, and merge each PR once its gates pass by exit code and an independent review finds nothing blocking. That covers #203 (the desk posts on every run), taking over your #180 branch (merge, not rebase), and creating the flow keeper's cloud trigger. Anything outside W1–W7, or a blocking finding I can't fix in scope, still stops and comes to you." The other options offered were: "Yes, but not the trigger", "Yes, but I merge #203", "Not yet". Recorded verbatim.
